output_list.criticism: The transferOwnership function does not have any access control, allowing any address to become the owner of the contract.
The transfer function does not have any access control, allowing any address to transfer tokens.
The transferFrom function does not have any access control, allowing any address to transfer tokens on behalf of others.
The approve function does not have any access control, allowing any address to approve spending of tokens on behalf of others.
The approveAndCall function does not have any access control, allowing any address to approve spending of tokens on behalf of others and call a specified contract.
The burn function does not have any access control, allowing any address to burn tokens.
The burnFrom function does not have any access control, allowing any address to burn tokens on behalf of others.
The buy function does not have any access control, allowing any address to buy tokens.
The sell function does not have any access control, allowing any address to sell tokens.
